description: Read the user's Answer Analysis: for the questions a brand's customers ask, how often live AI search (Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) named the brand, which competitors were named, and the change run over run. Call with NO argument to list the user's analyses with each brand's latest share of answers naming it and the direction; pass a brand name or project id to get that brand's full trend, per-provider breakdown, competitor comparison, average position, and short example answers. Reads data existing analyses have already collected — it does not trigger new runs, and it measures rather than promises. Read-only. Requires an API key on a plan that includes Answer Analyses (Monitor, Agency or the audit).

project.description: Brand name or project id to detail. Omit to list all monitored brands.
